title: Federated cognition: global core, specialist brains, regional reflex
statement: Intelligence is organised as a federation of a global cognitive core, specialist brains and regional reflex intelligence, not one central process that runs once.
rationale: A single central brain that runs once cannot react regionally and becomes a global single point of failure (§2 row 1).

verification.check: Composition roots exist for a central plane (qip-api/qip-fastbrain/qip-deepbrain) and a regional reflex binary (qip-edge-node) with no compile-time dependency between them; failing mutation: add qip-kernel to qip-edge-node's dependencies.

title: Dual-stream learning fused into one decision model
statement: World data (why prices may change) and tick/order-book data (how liquidity and prices react) are learned as two streams and fused into one opportunity and decision model.
rationale: Learning only from one stream misses either causal drivers or execution reality.

verification.check: A fused feature/state record joins a time-aligned world belief and a tick-derived microstructure feature, and a decision consumes it; removing either input changes the decision.

title: Numerous concurrent world models, not one monolith
statement: The platform maintains numerous concurrent world models across domains, regions, horizons and hypothesis branches rather than one monolithic representation.
rationale: A single representation forces premature collapse of disagreement (§1, §2 World Model Federation row).

verification.check: A running platform holds more than one registered world model with distinct scopes and they are consulted in the cycle; removing registration leaves the cycle with one model.

title: Neuro-symbolic fabric links neural output to symbolic checks
statement: A neuro-symbolic reasoning fabric connects neural perception and generative models to causal graphs, rules, temporal logic, constraints, probabilistic reasoning and executable proofs.
rationale: Reasoning left implicit inside generative models cannot be verified or audited.

verification.check: A neural/LLM proposal passes through a symbolic verifier (rules/constraints) that can reject it, and the rejection is journaled; mutating the verifier to accept-all makes the test fail.

title: Ambient model mesh runs continuously and wakes specialists
statement: An ambient model mesh runs continuously in the background, forecasting, searching weak signals, detecting contradictions, generating scenarios and waking specialist brains without being asked.
rationale: Models invoked only on request miss precursors no one asked about.

verification.check: A background loop in a composition root emits AmbientSignal/AttentionEvent records to the log without an external request; disabling the loop removes them.

title: Causal agency: simulate authorized interventions and learn effect
statement: The system reasons about which authorized actions could change the probability of a desired outcome, simulates them, executes only through governed tools, and learns their measured causal effect.
rationale: Forecast-only systems cannot learn which lawful actions change outcomes.

verification.check: A request flows goal -> levers -> candidates -> simulate -> gate -> act -> attribute, and the attribution is journaled; with the action policy absent the engine executes nothing.

title: Fast reflex reacts locally without waiting for the global brain
statement: The fast reflex system receives compressed knowledge, models, policy and capital envelopes and reacts to local market state without waiting on the global brain.
rationale: A hot path that waits on a global round trip turns any partition into an outage.

verification.check: A cell with the centre unreachable still runs passes and decides from local artefacts within the pass budget; making the pass await the centre fails the test.

title: Warm coordination layer between slow and fast systems
statement: A warm coordination layer sits between the slow cognitive and fast reflex systems for cross-region arbitrage, capital movement, portfolio management, market creation and settlement.
rationale: Without a warm tier, capital and cross-region coordination either block the hot path or wait days in the slow lane.

verification.check: A central component ingests cell reports and re-issues capital envelopes on a seconds-to-minutes cadence; removing ingestion leaves envelopes un-renewed.

title: Raw ticks normalized, reconstructed, replayed, distilled
statement: Raw ticks are not fed directly to the largest model; they are normalized, reconstructed into books, replayed and converted into learned microstructure representations that can be distilled into reflex models.
rationale: Feeding raw ticks to a large model wastes compute and leaks unreconstructed, mis-sequenced data into learning.

verification.check: Recorded venue bytes replay deterministically into books, and a distilled student model is produced from the replayed features; skipping reconstruction fails the replay equality test.

title: Reflex Mesh coordinates 2-20-leg opportunities with local autonomy
statement: Regional nodes communicate through a low-latency Reflex Mesh that coordinates 2-20-leg opportunities while preserving local execution autonomy.
rationale: Isolated regions cannot capture multi-region opportunities; a coordinating master would destroy local autonomy.

verification.check: Two cells exchange an opportunity epoch over a transport and each reserves its own leg; an epoch with 1 or 21 legs is refused.

title: Quantum used only where measurable advantage exists
statement: Quantum is a hybrid accelerator used only where measurable advantage against a classical baseline exists.
rationale: Quantum claimed without a baseline is not a result (ADR 0006).

verification.check: Every cycle that sizes a proposal journals the classical baseline and the improvement; a benchmark whose classical baseline fails reports nothing.

title: Quantum never confers truth or bypasses controls
statement: Quantum output never confers truth and never bypasses evidence requirements or deterministic controls; it is advisory and classically verified.
rationale: A QPU answer treated as an oracle would bypass the deterministic money controls.

verification.check: Quantum results are typed as advisory candidates that must be validated against the request and the classical objective before use; an unvalidated result is refused.

title: Route eligible work across CPU/GPU/TPU/QPU
statement: Eligible work is routed across CPU, GPU, TPU and QPU compute.
rationale: Fixed placement wastes expensive accelerators or starves workloads that need them.

verification.check: A router assigns a job to one of the four resource types by declared eligibility and records why; an ineligible type is refused.

title: Open-ended growth promoted through a controlled evaluation pipeline
statement: New information domains, ontology, specialist brains, tools and models may be added, but only through a controlled evaluation pipeline that promotes measured improvements.
rationale: Unbenchmarked self-extension would let regressions into production.

verification.check: A candidate capability is admitted only after a recorded benchmark beats the incumbent; removing the benchmark gate lets a worse candidate in.

title: Class-specific adapters and lifecycle engines per asset class
statement: Liquid, event-driven, illiquid, private, tokenized and physical assets are supported through class-specific adapters and lifecycle engines.
rationale: One generic asset model mis-values and mis-settles assets whose lifecycle differs.

verification.check: An asset-class registry maps each of the six classes to an adapter and lifecycle engine; an unregistered class is refused.

title: Represent uncertainty and contradiction explicitly
statement: World, causal, episodic, semantic and self models explicitly represent uncertainty and contradiction.
rationale: A model that hides contradiction presents false confidence.

verification.check: Beliefs carry a confidence/interval and contradictory evidence is recorded as a contradiction record rather than overwritten.

title: Autonomous operation only inside bounded authority
statement: Autonomous discovery, research, training, promotion, deployment, allocation and operation happen only inside bounded authority.
rationale: Unbounded autonomy makes the blast radius general.

verification.check: Autonomy changes go only through AutonomyController::request_change with an authenticated operator; a live ceiling stops the process.

title: Regional nodes peer-share compressed opportunity/state messages
statement: Regional nodes make fast local decisions and share compressed opportunity/state messages with peers.
rationale: Without peer sharing, cross-region opportunities wait on the centre.

verification.check: Two edge nodes exchange a compressed state/opportunity frame directly; a frame larger than the bound is refused.

title: Quantum always benchmarked against classical baselines
statement: Every quantum participation in optimization or learning is benchmarked against a classical baseline.
rationale: ADR 0006: a quantum path without a baseline cannot demonstrate benefit.

verification.check: A quantum family cannot be registered without a classical baseline and objective; registration with None is refused.

title: Financial-OS capabilities are first-class
statement: Asset management, capital management, risk management, treasury/custody, accounting/ledger, execution, settlement, market making, market creation and commerce are first-class capabilities.
rationale: Treating them as side components loses explicit contracts and ownership.

verification.check: Each named capability has an owning crate with a typed contract reached from a composition root.

title: No permanent fixed source/ontology/roster/model/tool catalogue
statement: No source list, ontology, specialist roster, model family or tool catalog is treated as permanent; gaps can generate new ones through governed promotion.
rationale: Fixed catalogues cap the system's intelligence at design time.

verification.check: Registries accept governed additions at runtime and record lineage; a gap observation produces a registered candidate.

title: Dual streams joined through time-aligned state
statement: World/causal and tick/order-book intelligence are joined through time-aligned state, embeddings, beliefs and outcome labels.
rationale: Misaligned joins leak future information or mislabel outcomes.

verification.check: A join refuses any world record whose knowable time is after the tick's event time; a mutation allowing it fails a property test.

title: Disagreement between world models represented explicitly
statement: A federation of domain, regional, horizon, scenario and counterfactual world models represents disagreement explicitly instead of collapsing it prematurely.
rationale: Premature consensus discards minority explanations that later prove right.

verification.check: Arbitration over conflicting models returns a Disagreement record preserving each view.

title: Symbolic layer verifies, combines or rejects neural proposals
statement: Neural models propose; symbolic logic, constraints, causal structures and proof traces verify, combine or reject them.
rationale: Unverified neural proposals cannot be audited.

verification.check: A neural proposal violating a rule is rejected with a recorded proof trace.

title: Interventions execute only through authorized action surfaces
statement: Causal agency executes interventions only through authorized action surfaces and learns which actions changed outcomes versus what would have happened anyway.
rationale: Actions outside an authorized surface cannot be governed or attributed.

verification.check: An action whose tool is not registered/authorized is refused and audited; attribution compares to a no-action counterfactual.

title: Always-on models activate specialists without a prompt
statement: Always-on models continuously forecast, simulate, monitor assumptions, search for weak signals and activate specialists without waiting for a prompt.
rationale: Specialists woken only on request react late.

verification.check: An AttentionEvent produced by the router wakes a named specialist and is journaled.

rationale: A managed bus as the nervous system adds a non-replayable, non-audited dependency on the core path.

verification.check: Central and edge processes publish and consume through the in-tree fabric and a replay reproduces state; deleting the fabric path breaks the replay test.

title: Each function lives in the fastest lane meeting its correctness
statement: Every function is assigned to exactly one time lane: the fastest lane that can meet its correctness requirements.
rationale: Placing work by aspiration puts slow, fallible work on the hot path.

verification.check: Every workspace crate has exactly one lane and a stated requirement, and no faster-lane crate depends on a slower one.

title: Lane 0 operates in ~10 us to 10 ms
statement: Lane 0 (feed decode, book update, features, reflex inference, predicates, local risk, netting, routing, order/quote generation) completes within ~10 us to 10 ms.
rationale: Missing the budget forfeits the reflex lane's reason to exist.

verification.check: Measured per-step costs of book apply, features, strategy, arbitrage, risk and order construction stay within budget; a slowed step fails.

title: Lane 0 has no remote dependency
statement: Lane 0 has no remote dependency.
rationale: A remote call in the order path couples latency and availability to the network.

verification.check: A pass completes with every remote peer unreachable.

title: Lane 0 uses compact features and distilled models
statement: Lane 0 uses compact tick-derived features/embeddings and distilled microstructure/reflex models.
rationale: Uncompressed models do not fit the hot-path budget.

verification.check: The cell consumes feature-DAG features and a distilled model in a pass.

title: Lane 0 never reads the historical Tick Lake in the order path
statement: Lane 0 never reads the historical Tick Lake in the order path.
rationale: Reading history on the hot path adds unbounded I/O latency.

verification.check: qip-edge does not depend on qip-storage and qip-edge-node never references Lake; adding a Lake read fails a scan.

title: Lane 1 coordinated-fast responsibilities
statement: Lane 1 (~1 ms to seconds) carries peer reflex messages, multi-region opportunity tokens, distributed inventory reservations, multi-leg coordination and hedge/unwind commands, accepting cross-region latency explicitly.
rationale: Coordination placed in Lane 0 would block on cross-region latency.

verification.check: Lane-1 messages flow between nodes with measured latency recorded.

title: Lane 2 tactical/warm responsibilities
statement: Lane 2 (seconds to minutes) carries portfolio/risk refresh, capital placement, treasury moves, market-making regime shifts, event repricing, cross-region inventory rebalancing, aggregated microstructure state, liquidity maps, execution-quality refresh, short-horizon fusion and bounded tactical interventions.
rationale: Tactical work in the slow lane is too late; in the hot lane it is too slow.

verification.check: The central cycle refreshes portfolio/risk and capital placement on a minute cadence.

title: Lane 3 cognitive slow responsibilities
statement: Lane 3 (minutes to days) hosts discovery, evidence synthesis, causal reasoning, research, hypothesis generation, simulation, strategy discovery, training/validation, tick replay, microstructure training, ambient models, symbolic reasoners, arbitration and intervention planning.
rationale: Slow work belongs off the decision path.

verification.check: Lane-3 crates are registered lane 3 and composed in qip-deepbrain.

title: Lane 4 quantum/research never blocks execution
statement: Lane 4 quantum-classical and research workloads are asynchronous and never block execution.
rationale: A queue-bound QPU call on the decision path makes execution depend on an external queue.

verification.check: Synchronous quantum jobs are refused at admission, and the decision path completes with the quantum provider unavailable.

title: Quantum output advisory and classically verified
statement: Quantum output is advisory and classically verified before use.
rationale: Unverified quantum output would act as a truth oracle.

verification.check: Every quantum answer is re-scored on the classical objective and only used if better by the threshold.

title: Signed model/strategy/belief/capital/risk packs flow to the reflex mesh
statement: Foundries and brains publish signed model, strategy, belief, capital and risk packs down to regional reflex cells.
rationale: Unsigned artefacts on the hot path let anyone steer capital.

verification.check: A cell installs only packs whose signature verifies; tampered packs are refused.

title: Americas, Europe and APAC reflex cells each run a local hot lane
statement: Reflex cells exist for Americas, Europe and APAC, each running a local hot lane against its markets.
rationale: One region serving all markets adds intercontinental latency to every order.

verification.check: Three execution nodes in three regions run passes.

title: Fills/events flow to ledger, treasury, settlement and inventory
statement: Fills and events from cells flow to ledger, treasury, settlement and inventory.
rationale: Fills not booked leave capital and positions wrong.

verification.check: A cell fill reported to the centre produces balanced ledger postings and inventory update.

title: Outcomes, episodes and missed opportunities feed the learning brain
statement: Outcomes, episodes and missed opportunities flow to a learning/evaluation brain that updates the world model and the tick/microstructure models.
rationale: Learning only from acted trades biases the system; non-actions must be scored too.

verification.check: The LEARN stage scores declined and filled opportunities and calibrates resolved beliefs each cycle.

title: Effect attribution with no-action counterfactual updates world model
statement: Actions taken through authorized surfaces are followed by effect attribution against a no-action counterfactual, which updates the world model.
rationale: Without the loop the system cannot learn which actions work.

verification.check: An executed intervention produces an attribution record consumed by a world-model update.

title: Scout -> Evidence & Truth -> World model ordering
statement: World data passes through the global scout, then evidence & truth, before reaching the world model/causal memory.
rationale: A record that skips the evidence gate reaches the world model unvetted.

verification.check: A record failing its quality gate is refused by name and never reaches the world model.

title: Tick capture -> normalize/clock -> book reconstruction -> Tick Lake
statement: Venue data is captured, normalized/clocked, reconstructed into books and stored in the Tick Lake, with live features and replay branching from it.
rationale: Skipping normalization or reconstruction corrupts every downstream feature.
